messages:
oncall-bot: :bangbang: Incident detected: multiple alert groups silenced for api-gateway + traces sparse. Rule: gateways.5xx_rate > 3x baseline. Notifying SRE rotation.

nora: I'm taking ops. Seeing synthetic failures for some endpoints and Datadog graphs are frozen at ~10:12 UTC. Raw logs are still arriving to our logging S3 but Datadog metrics and APM traces look delayed/partial.

kevin: Checked dd query via API, last metric timestamp 10:10, gap of ~12 minutes. Datadog status indicates 'ingestion delays' in the US ingest plane. Link: https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/ingest-us-1234

sree: Critical question: are customer alerts missing or just internal dashboards? We need to triage which customers rely solely on Datadog for alerting.

nora: Early impact list: two enterprise customers use only Datadog alert channels for their SLAs; also internal oncall notifications depend on our Datadog->PagerDuty integration. We might be missing external PD pages.

ops-robot: Confirm PD integration has a gap: outgoing events queued for DD->PD webhook. I can enable our PD relay to accept webhooks directly from our internal fallback if we send them. Proposal: if Datadog ack < 30s, route fire/resolve events via internal relay.

kevin: Good idea. Also enable Prometheus push for a small set of essential metrics (gateway_success, gateway_5xx, gateway_latency) with 15s scrape so we can keep alerting running.

nora: Actions:
- ops-robot: enable PD relay and queue replay
- kevin: enable Prom push for essential metrics
- sree: identify customers with Datadog-only alerts and notify CS
- nora: open ticket with Datadog and monitor status page

ops-robot: PD relay switched on and accepting events. I replayed the last 2 queued alerts; PD acknowledged. Commands I used:

```
# enable internal pd-relay
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/pd-relay RELAY_MODE=enabled
# replay queue
curl -X POST https://internal-relay/replay/alerts
```

kevin: Prometheus pushgateway configured for gateway_* metrics; scrubbed and visible in our internal Grafana in ~30s. Temporary rule added: alert if pushgateway.gateway_5xx > 5 for 1m -> route to PD.

datadog-bot: [Datadog] We are investigating ingestion delays in US regions. Some customers may see delayed metrics and traces. Engineers working on backlog. (https://status.datadoghq.com)

sree: I'm messaging CS with a short blurb: "Datadog is experiencing ingestion delays affecting dashboards & alert delivery. We have activated internal fallbacks (Prometheus + PD relay) and increased tracing retention. If you rely only on Datadog alerts for SLAs, please contact your CSM immediately." Posting to #customers-alerts?

nora: Yes post it. Also create a one-line status for our status page: "Partial observability degradation: Datadog ingestion delays; fallbacks active."

kevin: I've also increased trace retention and turned sampling to full for api-gateway for 20 minutes and started exporting spans to our cold store:

```
# set sampling
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/api-gateway TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0
# export spans
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/api-gateway SPAN_EXPORT=s3://telemetry-archive/ingest-fallback
```

ops-robot: Replay of PD events succeeded. We've instrumented fallback alerts; however, note: some noise expected while systems converge.

nora: Datadog support ticket opened: DD-98765. They're asking for account IDs and timestamps. I've provided ingestion examples and our monitoring screenshots.

datadog-bot: [Datadog] Update: backlog being processed, partial recovery in progress. Some metrics/traces are still delayed. ETA unknown.

sree: CS updated and sent to affected customers. Received immediate reply from one customer asking if their SLA-based paging may have missed an incident earlier. We should run a delivery audit.

nora: Agreed. ops-robot, can you produce a delivery audit of webhooks/alerts from 09:50-10:30 UTC and mark any undelivered events? We'll escalate for any missed customer pages.

ops-robot: Audit in progress. Preliminary: two alerts to customer-acct-125 failed to deliver to PD during the ingestion spike; they were replayed at 10:22 and PD created incidents then. I'll add that to timeline.

kevin: Datadog metrics slowly trickling back. Grafana shows recent datapoints at 10:25, gap closing. I'll keep Prometheus alerts active for another 30 minutes and then evaluate.

datadog-bot: [Datadog] Engineers report backlog clearing. Expect more metric continuity soon. If you still see missing data, provide examples to support.

nora: Handoff plan: I'll run coordination for another 20 minutes, then hand to kevin. If unresolved by 11:15 UTC escalate PD rotation. oncall-bot, set reminder.

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled: nora -> kevin at +20m. Escalation set to 1720104500 if incident not closed.

ops-robot: Audit complete: listed items:
- 2 PD pages delayed for customer-acct-125 (replayed)
- 0 other delayed deliveries for internal PD
- APM traces for 10:05-10:18 partially missing in DD, but full set archived to S3 export.

sree: Adding follow-up items: postmortem to include:
- external dependency risk matrix
- permanent fallback for core alerting (Prometheus + PD relay)
- test playbook for webhook replay

nora: Closing checklist now:
- PD relay enabled and replayed :white_check_mark:
- Prometheus fallback configured :white_check_mark:
- Trace sampling + archive :white_check_mark:
- DD ticket opened and tracked :white_check_mark:
- CS notified and customer audit started :white_check_mark:

nora: Will update this thread with any new DD updates. If any team sees customer-impacting issues beyond alert delivery, ping me.

kevin: DD shows recovery. I'll keep fallback rules active for 45 minutes and then roll back if stable.

oncall-bot: RESOLVED: Datadog ingestion incident reduced to normal. Thread closed by nora. (automated)

nora: Filing follow-up PM for postmortem and scheduling a tabletop next week to run through Datadog failure modes. Root detection ts 1720102468.
